label: Pinion Smart.Shift
description: Shows the current gear and battery level of a Pinion Smart.Shift gearbox as Karoo data fields, plus split fields pairing the gear with 3s cadence, 3s power, heart rate or 3s speed, with a low-battery alert at 20, 10 and 5 %. Unofficial: not affiliated with Pinion or Hammerhead. Built on Tim Angus's reverse engineering of the Smart.Shift Bluetooth protocol.
releaseNotes: New split fields that put the Pinion gear beside a Karoo value in one cell: 3s Cad + Gear, 3s Pwr + Gear, HR + Gear and 3s Spd + Gear (power and heart rate in zone colours), so a 2x2 page can show five values.
